messages:
nina: Quick follow-up from the token-metering postmortem (incident window Mar 9-15). We need owners for the backfill, reconciliation CSV, customer credits, and a durable detection alert. Keeping this thread as the operational checklist.

leo: I can own the backfill orchestration. Plan: dry-run on read-replica, sample-verify 250 accounts, then prod apply with pre/post checks. Will include an idempotency token on ingest and a debounce for aggregator retries.

devon: I'll own reconciliation and the credits ledger entries. Need a canonical query and a reproducible delta calc so accounting/audit can sign off. Also, suggest a pro-rata credit option for prorated subscriptions?

nina: Use the canonical ledger table billing.tokens_v3 for the reconciliation. Example query I'll run on replica:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS reconciled_tokens
FROM billing.tokens_v3
WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-09' AND event_time < '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
Run on replica and upload CSV to the private gist.

devon: CSV columns I'll produce: customer_id, billed_tokens, reconciled_tokens, delta_tokens, unit_price_usd, suggested_credit_usd, manual_review_flag. Credit formula: suggested_credit_usd = ROUND(MAX(0, billed_tokens - reconciled_tokens) * unit_price_usd, 2). manual_review_flag = true when delta_tokens / billed_tokens > 0.02 OR delta_tokens > 3000. ETA: Fri EOD for initial CSV.

leo: Dry-run scheduled Wed 04:00 UTC on replica. If dry-run looks good I'll open PR #1526 with the hotfix + idempotency guard and staging smoke tests. Prod run target Mon 03/16 02:30 UTC pending ops approval.

ops-bot: Ops window requested: Mon 03/16 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please confirm in #eng-oncall and attach the risk assessment.

billing-bot: Accounting note: will attach GL impact simulation after CSV upload. Early estimate: ~$12.3k (subject to reconciled delta).

nina: Add a durable detection: weekly job to compare ingest_lag and median_token_delta. Alert when ingest_lag > 45 minutes AND median_token_delta > 0.4% for a sustained 3 hours. Devon  add runbook steps and a dashboard panel.

devon: Will open an alerting + runbook PR referencing incident #489. Runbook will include: how to run the reconciliation query, how to trigger a dry-backfill, how to verify sample accounts, contact list, and rollback steps. ETA: Fri. Also adding unit/integration tests for the idempotency guard and a regression test for aggregator retry behavior.

leo: Pre-checks for prod backfill: checksum on 500 random accounts, totals_before <= totals_after <= expected_upper_bound, and a sample diff verification. Rollback = restore snapshot + revert patch. I'll include a small smoketest harness in the runbook.

nina: OK. Owners and timeline summary: leo = backfill & PR #1526, devon = reconciliation CSV & credits, nina = postmortem updates + customer escalation plan. Timeline: dry-run Wed, PR to staging Wed night, prod run Mon (ops window), credits processed Tue.

devon: For customer comms I'll draft two templates: a short notice for bulk credits and an escalation path for manually reviewed accounts. Will attach templates to CSV gist.

nina: I'll update the postmortem doc with owner matrix, PR links, and the weekly checkpoint calendar until two alert cycles pass and credits are posted. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
